llm.evidence: coupled on-line to a quadrupole orbitrap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany).
Cerebrospinal fluid from a longitudinal study group including 12 healthy control subjects was analyzed by label-free quantification (LFQ) via LC-MS/MS.
Tryptic digestion was performed at 37 °C overnight (16 hours) at a 1:50 (w/w) trypsin-to-protein ratio.
mass spectrometric analysis was performed in data-dependent scan mode.
MS/MS fragments were generated with a 27% normalized collision energy
Proteins were reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (final concentration) at 60 °C for 30 min.
Next, iodoacetamide was added for alkylation
